title: Chinese Vegetable Biryani
description: A flavorful and nutritious Chinese-inspired biryani dish packed with juicy vegetables and aromatic spices.

ingredients.name: Vegetables
ingredients.notes: Mixed vegetables such as carrots, bell peppers, and broccoli

instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the minced garlic and sauté for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the mixed vegetables and cook for 3-4 minutes until they start to soften.
Add the pre-cooked biryani rice and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes.
Add the diced juicy pineapple and soy sauce. Stir-fry for another 2 minutes.
Serve hot and garnish with chopped green onions if desired.
